query:
UPDATE webhook_delivery_attempt
        SET
            status = $4,
            completed_at = now(),
            duration_ms = $5,
            response_status = $6,
            response_headers_redacted = $7,
            response_body_preview = $8,
            error_kind = $9,
            error_message = $10
        WHERE id = $1
          AND webhook_delivery_id = $2
          AND attempt_number = $3
          AND status = $11
        RETURNING completed_at AS "completed_at!"
